mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises and UNRATE falls in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals a healthy economic expansion without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and CPIAUCSL falls in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 rises and CPIAUCSL falls.
